name: Vinyl
author: shoxjaxon
description: A minimal local music mini-player and music library for the Omarchy bar. Shows and controls what your local player (mpv, MPD, and other MPRIS players) is playing, and browses, searches, and plays a music folder you choose — with your own playlists — through mpv. No network access, no background scanning.

barWidget.description: Now-playing indicator with a mini-player and a music library
